import trimesh, numpy as np
import matplotlib
matplotlib.use("Agg")
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
m = trimesh.load("exports/model.box.e1af9484.stl")
sec = m.section(plane_origin=[-24,0,0], plane_normal=[1,0,0])
e = sec.entities[1]
pts = sec.vertices[e.points][:,1:]
c = np.array([-30.5, 30.8])
r = np.hypot(pts[:,0]-c[0], pts[:,1]-c[1])
print("n=",len(pts),"r min",r.min(),"max",r.max())
off = np.where(np.abs(r-2.3)>0.05)[0]
print("off-circle count:", len(off))
for i in off: print(f"  ({pts[i,0]:.3f},{pts[i,1]:.3f}) r={r[i]:.3f}")
fig,ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(7,7))
ax.set_aspect("equal"); ax.grid(True)
th = np.linspace(0,2*np.pi,200)
ax.plot(c[0]+2.3*np.cos(th), c[1]+2.3*np.sin(th), "r--", lw=1)
ax.plot(pts[:,0], pts[:,1], "o-", ms=3)
plt.savefig("/work/bore_loop.png", dpi=90)
print("saved")
